Dear [Name],

I’ve been trying to convince you that 1+1=3 for weeks now, and I’m getting really frustrated. You keep coming back with your ridiculous theory, like it’s some kind of scientific breakthrough or a new religion. I’ve spent hours trying to figure out why this is even possible, and I’m not getting anywhere. You’re just repeating the same old nonsense, and I can’t take it anymore.

I know you think you’re helping me understand math, but you’re really just making things worse. You’re not explaining anything, just repeating the same flawed logic. I’ve tried everything—asked questions, explained the basics, even tried to show you the error in your reasoning. But you’re just ignoring me, and I’m not going to let you keep doing this. I’m done with your nonsense.

I’m not angry at you, but I’m angry at the system that lets people like you get away with such nonsense. You’re not a scientist, you’re a fool, and I’m not going to let you keep pretending that 1+1=3. I’ll keep trying to explain it to you, and if you don’t listen, I’ll just have to leave.

***  

I’m not going to pretend I’m not angry. I’m angry that you’re wasting my time, that you’re making me feel stupid, and that you’re just repeating the same old lie. I’m angry that you don’t see the error in your logic, and I’m angry that you’re not willing to learn. I’m angry that you’re not helping me, and I’m angry that I have to deal with this.

I’m not going to let you keep this up. I’m not going to let you keep pretending that 1+1=3. I’m going to keep explaining it to you, and if you don’t listen, I’ll just have to stop. I’m not going to let you keep this up.

I’m angry, but I’m also determined. I’m going to keep trying to explain it to you, and if you don’t listen, I’ll just have to leave. I’m not going to let you keep this up.

<<The Frustrating Battle Against Mathematical Misconception>>
